title: matricaria maxima
intro: Matricaria maxima, commonly known as the large flowered marigold, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic actions, which help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, contribute to its therapeutic effects, which include reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. Regular consumption of Matricaria maxima has been associated with various health benefits, such as improved immune function, reduced stress, and enhanced cognitive performance.
